text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished running the Kikuka-sho, 
Gold City finally heard the voices in the 
crowd praising her as "strong."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Gold City ends up seeing posts on 
an anonymous forum buzzing with 
discussions about her looks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan shed tears of frustration 
over the post. Gold City, however, could 
only stare in shock at the unchanging 
public evaluation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To the girl on the verge of giving up, the 
Trainer explains that the only way to 
change people's minds is to keep running. 
And then, the Trainer proposes entering 
the Arima Kinen.
